searchText: Submitted PR 10/12 for review: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2947 This is the second time where I fixed a bug in my light client code, then see you made a PR to the spec that would have fixed it! Your PRs are great dood There are some test vectors that you can use to cross-check your implementation vs the spec reference. From `consensus-specs` repo root, use this command to generate vectors: `rm -rf ../consensus-spec-tests && make gen_light_client`. Format of the emitted files is described here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/tree/dev/tests/generators/light_client

There are some test vectors that you can use to cross-check your implementation vs the spec reference. 
From `consensus-specs` repo root, use this command to generate vectors: `rm -rf ../consensus-spec-tests && make gen_light_client`.
Format of the emitted files is described here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/tree/dev/tests/generators/light_client
